title: Verify Featured Projects section shows heading, Prev/Next buttons and slide count matching data-total
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in

test_data.note: exact titles and order are not asserted

steps: Scroll to the section with the h3 heading "Featured Projects"
Locate the Prev (#carousel__prev) and Next (#carousel__next) buttons
expected_result: The heading "Featured Projects" is visible. At least one slide exists and the slide count equals the data-total value (5 at the time of exploration). Both the Prev and Next buttons are present and visible.

title: Verify every slide has a non-empty title, a Technique line and a View Project link
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view

test_data.note: slide image loading is not asserted (known dev data issue)

steps: For each slide read the text of the h4 title
For each slide check that a "Technique:" line with a non-empty value is present
For each slide check that a link a.more-link with the text "View Project" is present
expected_result: Every slide has a non-empty h4 title, a "Technique:" line with a non-empty value, and an a.more-link link labelled "View Project".

title: Verify a slide without a "Pattern type" line renders no empty Pattern type row
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view
At least one slide has no "Pattern type:" line (Alma Lasers at the time of exploration); if every slide has one, the "absent" part of the check is not applicable
steps: For each slide check whether a "Pattern type:" line is present
For slides that have the line, read its value
For slides that do not have the line, inspect the slide text block for an empty "Pattern type:" label or an empty row
expected_result: Slides that have a "Pattern type:" line show a non-empty value. Slides without it show no "Pattern type:" label and no empty row; the rest of the slide (title, Technique, View Project) renders normally.

title: Verify the carousel starts on the first slide and does not autoplay
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view
steps: Reload the home page and scroll the Featured Projects section into view
Read the inline transform (translate3d X offset) of the slide track inside #projects-carousel and the first visible slide title
Wait 8 seconds without interacting with the page
Read the translate3d X offset and the first visible slide title again
expected_result: The first slide (item--0) is the first visible slide on load. The track offset and the first visible slide are identical before and after the 8-second wait (no autoplay).

title: Verify slide description is visible on desktop width
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view

test_data.note: long descriptions may be truncated with "..."

steps: For the first slide, read the .pt-box description text and check it is displayed
Click Next and wait about 1 second for the slide animation to finish; repeat the description check for the slide now in view
Repeat the previous step until every slide has been checked (or the carousel wraps)
expected_result: At desktop width the .pt-box description of each checked slide is displayed and non-empty. Truncation with an ellipsis ("...") is acceptable for long descriptions.
